request_routes.label: Adalimumab and biosimilars for labeled inflammatory indications
request_routes.routing_notes: Policy covers adalimumab products for the listed immunologic and inflammatory diseases with separate initial and continuation criteria.
request_routes.evidence: Section II details all indications considered medically necessary for adalimumab, and Section III describes continuation requirements for each listed disease.

route_guards.label: Tuberculosis screening prior to initiation when biologic naive
route_guards.evidence: For all indications: Member has had a documented negative tuberculosis (TB) test within 12 months of initiating therapy for persons who are naive to biologic drugs or targeted synthetic drugs associated with an increased risk of TB. If screening testing for TB is positive, there must be further testing to confirm there is no active disease. Do not administer the requested medication to members with active TB infection.

route_guards.label: No concomitant biologic or targeted synthetic therapy for same indication
route_guards.evidence: For all indications: Member cannot use the requested medication concomitantly with any other biologic drug or targeted synthetic drug for the same indication.

condition_clusters.evidence: Aetna considers adalimumab medically necessary for adult members with rheumatoid arthritis when the adult has previously received a biologic or targeted synthetic drug indicated for moderately to severely active RA within the past 120 days, or when treating moderately to severely active RA and meeting the biomarker and conventional synthetic therapy failure/intolerance/contraindication requirements described in Section II.A.

For members 2 years of age or older, adalimumab is medically necessary for articular juvenile idiopathic arthritis when the member has previously received a biologic or targeted synthetic drug indicated for moderately to severely active articular JIA, or has had inadequate response to methotrexate or another conventional synthetic drug administered at an adequate dose and duration, or has inadequate response to NSAIDs or intra-articular corticosteroids plus risk factors for poor outcome, including high-risk joints or elevated inflammatory markers.

Adalimumab is medically necessary for adult psoriatic arthritis when the member has previously received a biologic or targeted synthetic indicated for active PsA, or when treating active PsA if the member has mild to moderate disease with inadequate response or intolerance to methotrexate, leflunomide, or sulfasalazine, or has enthesitis/predominantly axial disease, or has severe disease.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Ankylosing spondylitis and non-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis (initial therapy)
condition_clusters.evidence: Adalimumab is medically necessary for adult ankylosing spondylitis or non-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis when the member has previously received a biologic or targeted synthetic indicated for active disease, or when treating active disease if the member has had an inadequate response to at least two NSAIDs or has intolerance or contraindication to two or more NSAIDs.

section_path: D. Ankylosing spondylitis (AS) and non-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis (nr-axSpA)

condition_clusters.evidence: Adalimumab is medically necessary for the treatment of moderately to severely active Crohn's disease.
Adalimumab is medically necessary for the treatment of moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis.

Adalimumab is medically necessary for adult plaque psoriasis when the member has previously received an indicated biologic or targeted synthetic, or for moderate to severe disease with crucial body areas affected, BSA over 10%, or BSA 3% with prior inadequate response, intolerance, or contraindication to phototherapy or pharmacologic treatment.

Adalimumab is medically necessary for members 12 years and older with moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa who have previously received a biologic, or who have had an inadequate response to at least 90 days of oral antibiotics for HS, or have an intolerance or contraindication to such antibiotics.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Non-infectious intermediate, posterior, and panuveitis (initial therapy)
condition_clusters.evidence: Adalimumab is medically necessary for members 2 years and older with non-infectious intermediate, posterior, or panuveitis who have had an inadequate response to corticosteroids or immunosuppressive therapy such as azathioprine, cyclosporine, methotrexate, or mycophenolate mofetil, or who have an intolerance or contraindication to those therapies.

section_path: I. Uveitis (non-infectious intermediate, posterior and panuveitis)

condition_clusters.evidence: Adalimumab is medically necessary for members who have previously received apremilast or a biologic for Behcet's disease, or when treating Behcet's disease in a member with an inadequate response to at least one non-biologic medication such as azathioprine, colchicine, cyclosporine, or systemic corticosteroids.

Adalimumab is medically necessary for members who have previously received a biologic for pyoderma gangrenosum, or for those with inadequate response to corticosteroids or immunosuppressive therapy such as cyclosporine or mycophenolate mofetil, or for those with intolerance or contraindication to those therapies.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Immune checkpoint inhibitor-related inflammatory arthritis (initial therapy)
condition_clusters.evidence: Adalimumab is medically necessary for treatment of immune checkpoint inhibitor-related toxicity in members with moderate or severe immunotherapy-related inflammatory arthritis who have had an inadequate response to corticosteroids or a conventional synthetic drug, or who have an intolerance or contraindication to those medications.

Continuation is medically necessary for adult members using adalimumab for moderately to severely active RA who achieve or maintain a positive clinical response with at least 20% improvement from baseline in tender joint count, swollen joint count, pain, or disability.

Continuation is medically necessary for members 2 years and older using adalimumab for moderately to severely active articular JIA who achieve or maintain a positive clinical response with improvement in joint counts or functional ability.

Continuation is medically necessary for adult members using adalimumab for psoriatic arthritis who achieve or maintain a positive clinical response with improvement in swollen or tender joints, dactylitis, enthesitis, axial disease, skin or nail involvement, functional status, or CRP.

condition_clusters.condition_label: Ankylosing spondylitis and non-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis (continuation)
condition_clusters.evidence: Continuation is medically necessary for adult members using adalimumab for ankylosing spondylitis or non-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis who achieve or maintain a positive clinical response with improvement in functional status, spinal pain, inflammation, swollen or tender joints, or CRP.

section_path: D. Ankylosing spondylitis (AS) and non-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis (nr-axSpA)

condition_clusters.evidence: Continuation is medically necessary for members using adalimumab for moderately to severely active Crohn's disease who achieve or maintain remission, or who demonstrate positive clinical response with improvement in abdominal pain, diarrhea, body weight, abdominal mass, hematocrit, mucosal appearance, or disease activity index scores.

Continuation is medically necessary for members using adalimumab for moderately to severely active UC who achieve or maintain remission, or who show improvement in stool frequency, rectal bleeding, urgency, CRP, fecal calprotectin, mucosal appearance, or disease activity scores such as UCEIS or Mayo score.

Continuation is medically necessary for adults using adalimumab for moderate to severe plaque psoriasis who achieve or maintain a positive clinical response as evidenced by reduction in BSA affected or improvement in signs and symptoms such as itching, redness, flaking, scaling, burning, cracking, or pain.

Continuation is medically necessary for members 12 years and older using adalimumab for moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa who achieve or maintain a positive clinical response with reductions in abscess and inflammatory nodule counts, new sinus tract formation and scarring, lesion frequency, pain, suppuration, relapse frequency, quality of life, or disease severity assessment scores.

Continuation is medically necessary for members 2 years and older using adalimumab for non-infectious intermediate, posterior, or panuveitis who achieve or maintain a positive clinical response with reduced flare frequency, stable or improved anterior chamber cell grade, vitreous haze, visual acuity, glucocorticoid requirements, or absence of new inflammatory retinal lesions.

section_path: I. Uveitis (non-infectious intermediate, posterior and panuveitis)

condition_clusters.evidence: Continuation is medically necessary for members using adalimumab for any indication outlined in Section II, including Behcet's disease, when they achieve or maintain a positive clinical response with low disease activity or improvement in signs and symptoms.

Continuation is medically necessary for members using adalimumab for any Section II indication, including pyoderma gangrenosum, who maintain a positive clinical response with low disease activity or symptom improvement.

Continuation is medically necessary for members using adalimumab for immunotherapy-related inflammatory arthritis who achieve or maintain a positive clinical response as evidenced by low disease activity or improvement in signs and symptoms.

criteria_catalog.prompt: Has the member had a documented negative tuberculosis test within the past 12 months if biologic/targeted synthetic-naive and no active TB infection is present?
criteria_catalog.clinical_intent: Confirm TB screening status before initiating adalimumab when the member is naive to biologics or targeted synthetics.
criteria_catalog.policy_time_language: For all indications, a documented negative TB test within 12 months is required prior to initiating therapy for biologic or targeted synthetic-naive members.
criteria_catalog.evidence: A documented negative TB test (skin test or IGRA) within 12 months of initiation is required for biologic- or targeted synthetic-naive members; positive tests require further evaluation to rule out active disease.

criteria_catalog.prompt: Is the member not using another biologic or targeted synthetic drug concomitantly for the same indication?
criteria_catalog.clinical_intent: Ensure adalimumab is not combined with another biologic or targeted synthetic for the same indication.

criteria_catalog.evidence: For all indications, the requested medication cannot be used concurrently with another biologic or targeted synthetic drug for the same condition.

criteria_catalog.prompt: Does the member have a diagnosis of moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis (RA)?
criteria_catalog.clinical_intent: Establish RA diagnosis for initial therapy.
criteria_catalog.evidence: Aetna considers adalimumab medically necessary for adult members with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) as described in Section II.A.

criteria_catalog.prompt: Has the member either previously received a biologic or targeted synthetic indicated for moderately to severely active RA within the past 120 days, or, for treatment of moderately to severely active RA, met the biomarker testing and conventional synthetic therapy failure/intolerance/contraindication requirements described in Section II.A?
criteria_catalog.clinical_intent: Confirm therapy prerequisites for RA.
criteria_catalog.evidence: Adult members must have previously received a biologic or targeted synthetic indicated for moderately to severely active RA within 120 days, or must be treated for moderately to severely active RA and meet the biomarker (RF, anti-CCP, CRP/ESR) testing and the methotrexate/conventional synthetic failure or intolerance criteria outlined in Section II.A.

criteria_catalog.prompt: Is the member age 2 years or older with moderately to severely active articular juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA)?
criteria_catalog.clinical_intent: Establish JIA diagnosis for initial therapy.
criteria_catalog.evidence: For members 2 years of age or older, adalimumab is medically necessary for articular juvenile idiopathic arthritis as described in Section II.B.

criteria_catalog.prompt: Has the member previously received a biologic or targeted synthetic for moderately to severely active articular JIA, or had inadequate response to methotrexate or another conventional synthetic at adequate dose/duration, or inadequate response to NSAIDs/intra-articular glucocorticoids plus risk factors for poor outcome, including high-risk joints or elevated inflammatory markers?
criteria_catalog.clinical_intent: Confirm therapy prerequisites for JIA.
criteria_catalog.evidence: Members must have either previously received a biologic or targeted synthetic indicated for moderately to severely active articular JIA, or must have had inadequate response to methotrexate/another conventional synthetic at adequate dose/duration, or inadequate response to NSAIDs/intra-articular glucocorticoids plus poor-prognosis features such as ankle, wrist, hip, sacroiliac, or TMJ involvement, erosive disease, elevated inflammatory markers, symmetric disease, or risk factors for refractory course.

criteria_catalog.prompt: Does the member have active psoriatic arthritis?
criteria_catalog.clinical_intent: Establish psoriatic arthritis diagnosis for initial therapy.
criteria_catalog.evidence: Adalimumab is medically necessary for adult members with active psoriatic arthritis as described in Section II.C.

criteria_catalog.prompt: Has the member had an inadequate response or intolerance to methotrexate, leflunomide, or another conventional synthetic drug, or is intolerant/contraindicated to them, or does the member have enthesitis/predominantly axial disease, or does the member have severe psoriatic arthritis?
criteria_catalog.clinical_intent: Confirm therapy prerequisites for psoriatic arthritis.
criteria_catalog.evidence: Members must have either previously received a biologic or targeted synthetic indicated for psoriatic arthritis, or, for mild to moderate disease, have inadequate response or intolerance to methotrexate, leflunomide, or sulfasalazine, or have enthesitis/predominantly axial disease, or must have severe disease.

criteria_catalog.prompt: Does the member have active ankylosing spondylitis or active non-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis?
criteria_catalog.clinical_intent: Establish AS/nr-axSpA diagnosis for initial therapy.
criteria_catalog.evidence: Adalimumab is medically necessary for adult members with active ankylosing spondylitis or active non-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis as described in Section II.D.

criteria_catalog.evidence: Members must have either previously received a biologic or targeted synthetic for active AS/nr-axSpA, or have had an inadequate response to at least two NSAIDs, or have intolerance/contraindication to two or more NSAIDs.
